filters: Exact target URL; weekly slot starts within requested inclusive-start/exclusive-end interval and capture completes before its endpoint.
First independently protected capture by actual capture time in each weekly slot, independent of pass/fail and producer.

Schema compilation is not behavioral correctness; latest schema requires a separate independent release-reference receipt.
evidence.collection: Offline digest-checked immutable capture archive; shared cursor inventory is discovery only. No APIs, fetched code execution or present-day historical reconstruction.
evidence.missingness: Missing assertions remain null; independently established partial native subtotals survive. Empty snippet inventory is zero only with protected complete extraction.
